message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_morphological_details_with_specialized_tools", "description": "When interpreting fine-grained morphological details (e.g., vessel vs. connective tissue) within a lesion, do not rely solely on generic report generators.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks requiring pixel-level discrimination or specific internal structural analysis of radiological findings where generic summarization tools may hallucinate or omit critical details.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["specialized_image_classifier", "pixel_analysis_tool"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the task requires distinguishing fine-grained morphological features (such as differentiating vessels from connective tissue inside a cystic lesion): (1) Do NOT rely exclusively on `chest_xray_report_generator` for these specific details; (2) Invoke a specialized tool capable of pixel-level analysis or specific feature classification (e.g., `specialized_image_classifier` or `pixel_analysis_tool`); (3) Cross-reference the specialized output with the general report to ensure consistency before finalizing the interpretation."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
